### Fixed
- `muster test`: `instance_logs` see the lines background work logs after the last step. The runner read the running instance's output once, right after the last step answered, so a line logged by work a call started in the background -- the core catalogue's age-triggered rebuild -- or still in the capture pipe was missing on a loaded CI machine, and `workflow-catalogue-age-refresh-on-production-schedule` failed on main with the rebuild counted on 0 lines. While a `contains` substring is missing or an `occurrences` count is below its value, the runner now keeps reading the output for up to ten seconds before it evaluates the block; a `not_contains` hit or an exceeded count is reported at once.
